operation: Seven independently generated 2×2 story pages, encoded as WebP. Panels displayed with CSS; captions remain accessible HTML.

episodes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one beautiful SQUARE cinematic comic page for the original sci-fi game Citadel. Input collector cards are CHARACTER IDENTITY AND PAINTING STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Remove all card frames, lettering and labels in this new illustration.
MANDATORY LAYOUT: exactly FOUR EQUAL SQUARE PANELS in a strict 2-by-2 grid on a perfectly square sheet. One straight narrow black vertical gutter at EXACTLY 50% canvas width; one straight narrow black horizontal gutter at EXACTLY 50% canvas height. No other subdivisions, no inset panels, no outer margin. Each panel is a complete independently readable composition, major figures must stay inside that panel, no border crossing. This will be cropped into 4 equal frames for a mobile game, so correct equal quadrant alignment is essential.
STYLE: rich premium hand-painted science-fiction graphic novel, cinematic deep perspective, finely engraved linework and tactile materials, confident readable silhouettes, detailed gothic orbital architecture, midnight navy, worn gold, teal, violet and amber light, dramatic compositions. Beautiful illustration, neither screenshot nor low-poly nor a plastic 3D toy. Sparse atmospheric particles, carefully controlled light, expressive human character.
HERO CONTINUITY: reference 1 is always the same adult male Analyst, dark tousled brown hair, strong eyebrows, fair skin, headset with microphone, navy flight suit with gold trim, practical dark chest armor, gloves. Same face and outfit across panels. His ship is a compact elegant TEAL fighter with TWO bright CYAN engines.
NO TEXT WHATSOEVER: no readable letters, numbers, titles, captions, speech balloons, logos, watermarks, blank caption panels or ornamental card borders. Geometric holograms only, no writing. No gore. Exactly four panels, arranged top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right in that narrative order.
Page 1, departure. TOP-LEFT: inside the grand orbital Citadel bridge, the reference hero receives a glowing golden-cyan holographic dossier from a brunette female analyst with hair in a bun; an elderly gray-bearded captain in navy-and-gold uniform watches, Earth and spires beyond windows, purposeful warm moment. TOP-RIGHT: the same hero climbs an open boarding ramp into his compact teal twin-engine spacecraft in an immense navy-and-gold hangar, angled low viewpoint, hands and feet anatomically correct, amber launch lights. BOTTOM-LEFT: wide exterior, teal fighter streaks out from the colossal ivory-and-gold orbital Citadel above the blue curve of Earth, TWO clean cyan engine trails, sense of adventure. BOTTOM-RIGHT: ominous distant archive station ahead, its heavy industrial gate glowing red, foreground silhouette of a white-and-graphite armored guard with red optics and a robotic canine beside him, hero ship a tiny approaching teal spark. Establish destination, no violence yet.
